description: AML check for one Bitcoin transaction: the laundering-pattern case this node logged for it in the last 30 days (score, level, rules fired such as peel chains, post-mix consolidation, structuring), or a clear no-case answer. Heuristic, not proof. Paid per call. Price: 50 sats or US$0.05 (USDC) per call.

pay_with.description: Optional. 'lightning' returns a BOLT11 invoice and a token instead of the x402 payment request.
